timer: std::chrono::steady_clock, nanoseconds; only the planner call is between the two reads
logging: std::cout has no stream buffer for the whole run, so library prints return after a state check; BFS::findPath still executes its per-node print statements
pinning: pinned to logical processor 0 (efficiency class 1 of 2 classes; higher is faster); process priority above normal, thread priority highest
background_cpu_load_definition: CPU time of all other processes during this command / (wall time x logical processors); -1 if the platform does not report it
order: per query and repetition the four variants run back to back, in an order rotated by query and repetition; one solver object per variant is reused for every query
astar_first_query_note: fresh AStar objects, query 0: the first call includes the O(E) heuristic-scale pass, the second reuses it
